name: Evolving Mobile Detailing
address_source: Google Business Profile does not publish a street address (mobile/service-area business, pin location near Kendall, Miami-Dade). Per FORGE-BRIEF variante adaptada: no address published -> map/location section omitted, replaced with a real work photo.
phone_source: Google Business Profile, confirmed on two separate fetches (gmaps_detail.js)
has_own_site_evidence: Verified NO own website. (1) Google Business Profile 'Website' field is empty (shows 'Add website' prompt) on the live profile, confirmed on two separate fetches. (2) curl -I on evolvingmobiledetailing.com, evolvingmobiledetail.com, evolvingdetailing.com, evolvingmobiledetailingmiami.com all returned connection failures (no DNS/no host). (3) WebSearch '"Evolving Mobile Detailing" Miami instagram facebook' and '"Evolving Mobile Detailing" Ricardo Miami website email' returned no official site or social profile for this exact business; only unrelated Miami-area detailers (Don's Detailing, Reyes Detailing, Perfect Shine 305, etc.) came up, none of which are this business.

social_media.evidence: No matching Facebook or Instagram profile found after two targeted WebSearch queries. Other Miami mobile detailers with similar generic names surfaced in results but do not match this business's name, phone, or owner (reviews repeatedly name the owner as 'Ricardo').

email_search_note: Deep search performed, no public email found: Google Business Profile has no email/contact-us field, no Facebook/Instagram profile located to check a bio link, no Linktree/website. Consistent with FORGE-BRIEF's observation that home-service and auto trades rarely publish an email; phone/SMS is the real channel for this business.

google_business.hours: Open 7 days a week, 4 AM to 12 AM (per live Google Business Profile hours)
google_business.attributes: Identifies as Black-owned, Latino-owned; LGBTQ+ friendly (per GBP attributes)

owner_name: Ricardo (named consistently across 4 of the 5 distinct Google reviews pulled: Marcus Assis, Aimee Green, Barbara Lopez, Heather T.)
services_source: No price list published anywhere (mobile detailing is quoted per vehicle, consistent with the variante adaptada rule). Service scope derived from the GMB category ('Car detailing service') and from review text describing full interior + exterior detailing, delivered at the customer's location.

services.flagship: Full Mobile Detail (interior + exterior, at the customer's home, office or parking lot)
services.interior: Interior Deep Clean (vacuum, dashboard, console, interior glass)
services.exterior: Exterior Wash & Shine (hand wash, wheels, tires, exterior glass)
services.pricing_note: No fixed price list on any source checked. Site uses 'Quote by vehicle' / call-or-text-for-a-quote framing, no invented dollar figures.

reviews_verbatim.text: Ricardo at Evolving Mobile Detailing not only delivered an exceptional car detailing service but also impressed me with his friendly and informative approach. He took the time to evaluate my car and discussed exactly what it needed. His … (truncated by Google's UI)

reviews_selected_for_site_note: Used Marcus Assis, Aimee Green and Heather T in full (their text was fully recoverable, not truncated by Google's UI). Trimmed Aimee Green's and Heather T's quotes to the first complete sentences for card length, no words altered within the kept sentences; emoji stars dropped from Marcus Assis's quote as purely decorative. barbara cotto-perez and Barbara Lopez's reviews were cut short by Google's own UI ('...') and the full text could not be recovered from this research pass, so they were not used on-site to avoid an incomplete/misleading quote.

dm_message: Hi! I built Evolving Mobile Detailing a free sample website after seeing your 5.0 stars (24 reviews) on Google. Check it out: https://siteforge-demos.odd-forest-9504.workers.dev/evolvingmobiledetailing/ It does not affect your current listing or operations. Happy to put it on your own domain, or take it down if it is not for you, no pressure either way. Michael, Merktop.
notes: Research performed via scripts/gmaps_detail.js, scripts/gmaps_reviews.js and scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js against the live Google Maps place URL, curl domain probes for own-website verification, and WebSearch for social/email discovery. Build derived from templates/dark-v2/index.html via an anchored Python transformation script (badge-protected palette swap, section-by-section content replacement, full regex replace of the services and gallery grids), following FORGE-BRIEF's variante adaptada for the missing address (map section replaced with a real photo) and missing prices (quote-based CTA, no invented dollar figures). gate.py passed (GATE OK, lang en) before this file was written. No data invented; every field above is either a verified value with its source noted, or null with a documented search.
